description:
Property Reference: 3009605.

Spacious 5-Bed HMO Flat in Morningside – Ideal for Students or Young ProfessionalsA bright, spacious and well-presented 5-bedroom HMO flat in the heart of Morningside, ideally suited to a group of students or young professionals looking for a comfortable home in one of Edinburgh’s most popular neighbourhoods.

The property is fully furnished and equipped for everyday living, with five bedrooms, a separate living/dining room, separate kitchen and bathroom. Situated on the first floor and benefiting from double glazing and gas central heating, the flat is generally warm and cosy throughout the year.

HMO licensed for up to 5 people.

Living & Dining RoomOne of the real advantages of the flat is the separate living room, giving everyone a comfortable communal space to relax and socialise.

It includes a large modern sofa with chaise, armchair, coffee table and TV unit, together with a dining table and five chairs – ideal for shared meals, studying or spending time together.

The room is comfortably furnished with lamps, side tables and artwork to create a warm and homely feel.

KitchenThe separate kitchen is fully equipped and offers plenty of cupboard and worktop space. It includes:

DishwasherWashing machineFridge-freezerOven and hobExtractor fanPlenty of storageBedroomsThere are three particularly spacious double bedrooms and two smaller bedrooms.

Each bedroom is furnished for both sleeping and studying and includes:

Comfortable bed with a good-quality thick mattressWardrobe with hanging and drawer storageDesk and chairMirrorPinboardSome of the larger bedrooms also have their own sofa or armchair, providing additional private living space.

BathroomThe bathroom has a bath with an over-bath shower, WC and washbasin.

There is also direct access from the flat to the communal back green.

Fantastic Morningside LocationThe flat is located in the heart of Morningside, with an excellent selection of cafés, restaurants, shops and supermarkets virtually on the doorstep.

Waitrose, Marks & Spencer and Sainsbury’s are all within easy walking distance, together with numerous independent cafés, bakeries and local shops.

The location is particularly convenient for students at Edinburgh Napier University and the University of Edinburgh. Edinburgh University Kings Buildings are on direct bus route close or a bike ride away. Edinburgh Napier University Merchiston Campus is just a few bus stops away or a short walk. It is also well connected to other university campuses.

A bus stop is approximately 2 minutes' walk away, with regular services towards:

Edinburgh city centreEdinburgh Napier University – Merchiston CampusEdinburgh Napier University – Craiglockhart CampusUniversity of Edinburgh – King's BuildingsMorningside is a lively and very popular residential neighbourhood, offering the convenience of city living while still having a strong local community feel.
